plan.title: SpringGear ordered JDK21 migration
plan.summary: Build alignment, executable behavior tests, full verification and local Sandbox release.

delivery_scope.inclusion_basis: Complete selected JDK21 design; no partial obligation selection.

work_items.outcome: Align the reactor build and processor dependencies for JDK21.
work_items.completion_criteria: POMs explicitly target JDK21 and retain public Java source.
work_items.expected_evidence: Exact preconditioned POM changes and content checks.

work_items.outcome: Add and execute JDK21 behavior regression and migration instructions.
work_items.completion_criteria: Ten real compatibility tests and migration notes exist and Maven verify succeeds.
work_items.expected_evidence: Current immutable result, actual Maven test output and packaging log.

work_items.outcome: Verify the full current migration requirement and design.
work_items.completion_criteria: All current objectives have real passing JDK21 behavior evidence.
work_items.expected_evidence: Actual current-subject Maven/JUnit output and source hashes.

work_items.outcome: Qualify the approved version in a disposable local Sandbox.
work_items.completion_criteria: The exact qualified version is applied and observed on the local target.
work_items.expected_evidence: Bound release effect and target version readback.
